body:
Founder hit a real bug: with 170 open Inbox items, that column grew far taller than the viewport, so scrolling down scrolled the other columns' drop targets out of view too -- couldn't drag between them. Fixed with two changes: (1) every column is now max-height:calc(100vh-12rem) with its own independently-scrolling card list (standard Trello pattern) so all 4 columns stay visible at once; (2) every card gets an always-visible 'Send to...' select as a precise, keyboard/touch-friendly alternative to dragging, sharing the same sendToQueue() logic as drag-and-drop. go build/test + GOWORK=off clean, go vet clean, live iduna.service rebuilt/restarted. Commit 190fc31.

⚓ ☃
title: S234-03: fixed kanban drag-across-scroll UX bug (scrollable bounded columns + send-to select)
